title: Canonicalize implementation-lug review/reconciliation workflow
description: Turn the observed review/reconciliation pattern from implementation-canonical-runtime-baseline-v1 into first-class durable behavior for implementation lugs. Extends the implementation-lug object model with review_notes, review_cycles, and acceptance tracking, updates canonical guidance, and establishes the workflow so review notes, remediation, recheck, and final acceptance all live on the same object.
target_deliverables: Extended implementation-lug object model with review_notes[], review_cycles[], acceptance fields
Lifecycle/status support for review states: planned → review_pending → approved_to_implement → in_progress → in_remediation → ready_for_recheck → implemented → accepted
Updated canonical guidance for implementation-lug behavior with persistent review requirements
Updated implementation-canonical-runtime-baseline-v1 with new fields and actual review note for WAI-Signals.jsonl references
Follow-up record for lug storage cleanup including backup file rescue
scope_boundaries: Keep changes tightly scoped to implementation-lug workflow
Preserve backward readability of current lugs
Prefer additive schema evolution over destructive restructuring
Do not broaden scope beyond implementation-lug workflow and related guidance
verification_gates: Active example lug reflects remediation reality, not false full acceptance
Workflow understandable from files alone without chat context

review_cycles.summary: Self-review: Implementation scope appropriate, extends object model additively, updates guidance in templates and WAI-Spoke versions, creates concrete example with real review note. Changes stay within implementation-lug workflow boundaries.

acceptance.notes: Implementation complete: Extended object model, updated canonical guidance, created example with real review note, established workflow

observations: Object model extended with comprehensive review/reconciliation fields
Canonical guidance updated in both templates and WAI-Spoke versions
implementation-canonical-runtime-baseline-v1 updated with real review note and correct status
Workflow establishes durable review trail independent of chat context
follow_up_candidates: Apply remediation workflow to implementation-canonical-runtime-baseline-v1 WAI-Signals.jsonl references
Test new review workflow with future implementation lugs
Consider broader application to other lug types

checks: Scope is bounded to implementation-lug workflow behavior and related guidance
